philosophy: Priority is a sum of labeled contributions. Every point has a human-readable reason. No opaque model scores.

factors.label: Known exploitation
factors.description: Public evidence that exploitation is occurring or has occurred (e.g. KEV listing).

factors.label: Severity
factors.description: Attention urgency of the subject (critical → info).

factors.label: Public exploit availability
factors.description: Whether public reporting indicates exploit code or weaponization exists — literacy only, never include payloads.

factors.label: Patch availability
factors.description: Missing or delayed patches raise priority; available patches still matter for awareness.

factors.label: Industry relevance
factors.description: Overlap with industries the observer cares about.

factors.label: Recency
factors.description: How recently the subject changed or was disclosed.

factors.label: Trusted sources
factors.description: Count of government/vendor/standard citations supporting the picture.

factors.label: Owner interest
factors.description: Local preference — bookmarks, watchlist, or manual boost. Stays on device.

factors.label: Confidence
factors.description: Higher confidence supports acting on the other factors; low confidence caps urgency theater.
